:::{#thm-conditional-entropy-average}
#### Conditional entropy as an average of entropies given a value

For $X$ and $Y$ as in @def-joint-surprisal,

$$\entropyf{Y \mid X} = \sum_{x} p(x) \, \entropyf{Y \mid X=x},$$ {#eq-conditional-entropy-average}

where $p(x) \eqdef \P(X=x)$,
and the sum runs over the values $x$ with $p(x) > 0$.

:::

::: {.proof}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\entropyf{Y \mid X}
&= \Expfc{X}{\Expfc{Y \mid X}{\surprisalf{Y \mid X} \given X}} \\
&= \sum_{x} p(x) \, \Expfc{Y \mid X=x}{\surprisalf{Y \mid x} \given X=x} \\
&= \sum_{x} p(x) \, \entropyf{Y \mid X=x}.
\end{aligned}
$$ {#eq-conditional-entropy-average-2}

The first line is @thm-conditional-entropy-iterated,
the second line is the [definition of expectation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) over the values $x$ of $X$,
and the last line is @def-entropy-given-value.

:::
